suggestedOps.refusal.nameTaken.suggestio: Be Cmdr att föreslå ett annat namn.

@suggestedOps.server.field.port.sameAsSourceJustification: The network port is port in Swedish (sv/terms.json port ruling, MS terminology), like settings.developer.mcpPort.label. Deliberately identical.

@suggestedOps.server.field.bucket.sameAsSourceJustification: S3 users and Swedish cloud consoles keep bucket (sv/terms.json bucket ruling), like servers.sheet.s3Bucket. Deliberately identical.
